coverage_notes.baseline_comparison: 10/15 direct checks accessible versus 11/15 in prior verified run. Four persistent USDA/Guam/Maine limitations and one intermittent 403 at Forgotten Harvest, already observed in prior secondary fetch. No new material coverage deterioration established.
coverage_notes.search_limitations: Targeted search index was noisy, with older grocery-loss and 2025 SNAP stories; publication-time granularity for local Arkansas baby-pantry notice insufficient to place report inside hour. Social-only notices, indexing delays and inaccessible government/provider pages limit recall. No findings is not proof of absence.
coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Donation drives, guides, recipes, opinion, routine promotions, inflation, preannounced or older events, and duplicates excluded.
coverage_notes.operations: No approval, publishing, production modification, schedule adjustment, automation disabling, or unrelated repository mutation.
